content.comment_body: Hello, I encountered a similar issue when trying to send emails from my [product_name]. Eventually, I was able to send emails successfully using these settings: SMTP server: smtp.gmail.com, Port: 587, Encryption: STARTTLS (if available), Email address: [user_email], Name: [user_email], Password: Gmail account password. For CA certificate, I did not load any file. I did not make changes to my firewall; instead, I allowed 'less secure applications' in my Google account settings. I sent a test email to a user I created with another email address, and this worked even though that recipient did not provide a phone number. The setup worked for me without loading any CA certificate, although I did try some certificate files using OpenSSL with no success. Kind regards, [user_name]

This thread has been closed because the question was posted twice. The duplicate thread with the subject 'Unable to connect using OpenVPN' can be found in the [product_name] - Communication section. Regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: A user shared their successful approach to sending email from a [product_name] using Gmail SMTP settings after multiple attempts. They highlighted that it worked without uploading CA certificates, but required enabling 'less secure apps' on Google. The experience indicates users face challenges with email configuration, especially regarding certificates and security settings. Resolution relied on experimentation, showing a lack of clear product guidance or support.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward email sending from the [product_name] using popular email services like Gmail, minimal security obstacles, and step-by-step instructions for configuring necessary settings.
